translation:
Treats sudden redness, swelling, and pain. Those of the northern regions who are robust in body should take it.

Aged Mahuang, Jingjie spikes, white Jiegeng, Niubangzi, and Zhuang Dahuang, cut into slices, one qian and three fen each, made into one dose, with five qian of fresh ginger and two liang of scallion heads as the guiding agents. After taking it, when the swelling subsides and the redness recedes, still use the Jinye Decoction for three or four doses, and externally apply the Yuhua Elixir.
translator_notes: 莊大黃 (Zhuang Dahuang) refers to high-quality rhubarb.
引 (yin) refers to the guiding agent that directs the effect of the medicine.
